arxiv-2210-13607.title: KPZ fluctuations in the planar stochastic heat equation
arxiv-2210-13607.creator: Jeremy Quastel and Alejandro Ramírez and Bálint Virág
arxiv-2210-13607.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Jeremy Quastel and Alejandro Ramírez and Bálint Virág. We use a version of the Skorokhod integral to give a simple and rigorous formulation of the Wick-ordered stochastic heat equation with planar white noise, representing the free energy of an undirected random polymer. The solution for all times is expressed as the L 1 L^{1} limit of a martingale given by the Feyman-Kac formula and defines a randomized shift, or Gaussian multiplicative chaos.

arxiv-2505-17945.title: Towards Industrial Convergence : Understanding the evolution of scientific norms and practices in the field of AI
arxiv-2505-17945.creator: A. Houssard
arxiv-2505-17945.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by A. Houssard. In the field of artificial intelligence (AI) research, there seems to be a rapprochement between academics and industrial forces. The aim of this study is to assess whether and to what extent industrial domination in the field as well as the ever more frequent switch between academia and industry resulted in the adoption of industrial norms and practices by academics.

arxiv-2507-22103.title: Hamiltonian Truncation of Large 𝑵 𝒇 N_{f} QED and Large 𝑵 N Vector-like Theories in 𝒅 = 𝟐 + 𝟏 d=2+1
arxiv-2507-22103.creator: A. Liam Fitzpatrick, Anastasiia Novikova, Noah Ring
arxiv-2507-22103.description: Abstract We consider a general class of large N N vector-like theories in d = 2 + 1 d=2+1 in a Hamiltonian approach. We show that by using lightcone quantization and the N → ∞ N\to\infty limit, we can diagonalize the Hamiltonian exactly and construct the eigenstates, spectral density, S-matrix, and form factors for the theory.

arxiv-2511-22788.title: PRISM: Privacy-Aware Routing for Adaptive Cloud–Edge LLM Inference via Semantic Sketch Collaboration
arxiv-2511-22788.creator: Junfei Zhan, Haoxun Shen, Zheng Lin, Tengjiao He
arxiv-2511-22788.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate impressive capabilities in natural language understanding and generation, but incur high communication overhead and privacy risks in cloud deployments, while facing compute and memory constraints when confined to edge devices. Cloud–edge inference has emerged as a promising paradigm for improving privacy in LLM services by retaining sensitive computations on local devices.

pmc-11578889.title: Ladder fuels rather than canopy volumes consistently predict wildfire severity even in extreme topographic-weather conditions
pmc-11578889.creator: Christopher R. Hakkenberg, Matthew L. Clark, Tim Bailey, Patrick Burns, Scott J. Goetz
pmc-11578889.description: Drivers of forest wildfire severity include fuels, topography and weather. However, because only fuels can be actively managed, quantifying their effects on severity has become an urgent research priority. Here we employed GEDI spaceborne lidar to consistently assess how pre-fire forest fuel structure affected wildfire severity across 42 California wildfires between 2019–2021.

pmc-12494407.title: Rapidly Progressive Metastatic Adrenocortical Carcinoma With Oncocytic Features in a Young Male: A Case Report
pmc-12494407.creator: Sultana Jannatun Nahar, G K M Rashik Uzzaman, Ibnul Shams, Muhammad Asif Iqbal Rao, Cornelius Fernandez
pmc-12494407.description: Adrenocortical carcinoma (ACC) is a rare but highly aggressive endocrine malignancy, often diagnosed at an advanced stage with limited treatment options and a poor prognosis. pmc-13069932.description: Introduction ERBB2 is amplified or overexpressed in 15% to 20% of primary invasive breast cancers. pmc-13283967.description: BackgroundAmyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a progressive and incurable neurodegenerative disease that not only affects motor function but is also associated with gastrointestinal and emotional disturbances.
